### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/package.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via /security/permission-sets/:name/clone (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via /security/permission-sets/:name/clone (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`  _(via /security/permission-sets/:name/clone (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/package.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **188** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2e9e1ac9dce8823d84e03ad3787f722c15511d20` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8674f0a89a00421159d0e18cf1ffb069019a9178` — the merge of head `111a0f32d88db674c82430f22b710fa48484affc` into base `2e9e1ac9dce8823d84e03ad3787f722c15511d20`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8674f0a89a00421159d0e18cf1ffb069019a9178 && git checkout 8674f0a89a00421159d0e18cf1ffb069019a9178
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 2e9e1ac9dce8823d84e03ad3787f722c15511d20 111a0f32d88db674c82430f22b710fa48484affc && git checkout -B drift-repro 2e9e1ac9dce8823d84e03ad3787f722c15511d20 && git merge --no-ff 111a0f32d88db674c82430f22b710fa48484affc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2e9e1ac9dce8823d84e03ad3787f722c15511d20
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 2e9e1ac9dce8823d84e03ad3787f722c15511d20` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：几条拒绝提示改说人话。软件包自带的权限集不能改时，提示里指向界面上真实的「新建类似」按钮，而不是不存在的「克隆」。拼错的配置项不再被乱猜成不相干的词。命令行打错命令时会告诉你去哪看帮助。
- 为什么做：测试中发现这些提示要么指向不存在的按钮，要么给出误导的猜测。
- 出错会怎样：只是提示文字，不改变任何允许或拒绝的结果，撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `111a0f32d8` · 2026-11-19T08:38Z
- **Shape:** 15 files, +314/−39. Not governed (check-governed: NOT governed, 353 lines). K = 13 since base `c05a8a01`, and it merges cleanly into current main. One non-test `packages/spec/src/**` file (`shared/suggestions.zod.ts`) changes, so the seat owes a CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER L2.
- **Fixes vs card (#33345, five rows):**
  - **130:** `ITEM_LOCKED` (metadata-protocol `PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME.permission.routes.clone`) and plugin-security's `LOCKED_USER_TEXT` / `PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN_USER_TEXT` now name the control by its console label. I checked that `perm.clone.action` is 'New similar' / '新建类似' in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`. Two docs rows that quote the sentence follow the same change.
  - **164:** a new oclif `command_not_found` hook. It keeps exit 2 and the hard refusal, guesses nothing, spells the id the way it was typed, and points at the help of the deepest topic the typed words reached. Its registration in `package.json` is pinned against the built `dist` path.
  - **233:** `connect-mcp.mdx` now separates 404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` for a non-reader from 403 `FORBIDDEN` for a reader.
  - **60:** an empty key now reads `an empty key (`""`)` and gets no guess. A key of 5 characters or fewer keeps a guess only at OSA distance ≤ 1, so `nmae`/`lable` are still answered and `aria` → `areas` is gone. Keys of 6 or more characters take the unchanged path.
  - **108:** dropped as already fixed at `40c73a8f4f`, with the evidence in the body.
  - Row 60's root `invalid_union` wrapper went to #35400 (p2, nested under #33345) on Bill's option A (7003683081). So `Fixes #33345` is right.
- **Changeset (read sentence by sentence):** patch on spec, metadata-protocol, plugin-security and cli. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are correct, because only words change and no input is newly accepted or refused. Each bullet matches its code: the `lable` → `label` case is one adjacent swap, which passes the screen. Nothing is BREAKING.
- **Pins:** each row has a red-then-green pin at its producer, added as a top-level describe in the existing harness files (`strict-object.test.ts`, `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`). The exact-sentence pins in metadata-protocol and rest now read "New similar". The CLI hook has its own unit test.
- **Gates:** CI on `111a0f32` is 63 success and 12 skipped, with 0 failed and 0 pending.
- **Deviations accepted:**
  - The row-130 surface grew to plugin-security's matching refusal, in all 11 locales, and to the two docs pages that quote the sentence. That is the same sentence at every door, which is what the regime row's own comment asks for.
  - zh-Hant reads 「新建类似」 in Simplified script, and the other locales quote the English label. That is the label the console actually draws, since the designer strings ship only `en` and `zh`, and the code comment says so.
  - The first content push came before the overlap check, which was clean right after. Process only.
- **Out of scope:** the copy defects need cards, nested under #33345 per the sub-issue rule. ux-3 files one p3 card for:
  - the `max(2, len/3)` rename budget copied in four other spec files (object, seed, field-value, default-value-shape), which can give the same short-key misguess;
  - the retired form key `defaultSort` being answered with 'defaults'.

  These need no card:
  - the released migration note that says 'Clone', because it is history and stays as written;
  - the stale test header and the retired checklist item. They can ride the same card as a nit, or be dropped.
- **Landing clause:** not governed, so ux-3 lands it after the seat's L2 record. K < 15, so no main merge is required. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `111a0f32d88db674c82430f22b710fa48484affc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.test.ts

Inputs read: card #33345 (body and every comment through the dev report 7003316873), PR #35397 (body, file list, net diff against `main`), the 75 check-runs on this head (63 success, 12 skipped, 0 failed). The rest of the diff (cli hook, metadata-protocol regime row, plugin-security locale texts, docs, changeset) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged — right.** `strictUnknownKeyError` returns a message string for an `unrecognized_keys` issue and nothing else. The three edits sit inside that map: `renderUnknownKey` (how a key is printed), `if (key === '') continue` (skips the rename channel for the empty key, placed after the `guidance` and `guidanceSets` lookups so an exact or set prescription for it still fires), and `shortKeyScreenedGuess` in place of `findClosestMatches(...)[0]`. None can turn a refused input into an accepted one or the reverse; the issue's `code`, `path` and `keys` are zod's and are not touched.
- **Public surface: unchanged — right.** `renderUnknownKey`, `adjacentSwapDistance` and `shortKeyScreenedGuess` are module-private. The exported `levenshteinDistance`, `findClosestMatches`, `formatSuggestion`, `keySetMatches`, `strictUnknownKeyError` and `StrictUnknownKeyErrorOptions` keep their signatures and, for the first four, their bodies. No published field, option or export is removed.
- **What does move: advisory text on keys of five characters or fewer.** A short key whose nearest declared key is two plain edits away (not an adjacent swap) used to get `Did you mean`, and now gets none; an empty key prints as "an empty key" with the two-quote code span instead of an empty code span. Keys of six characters or more take the old path byte for byte (`Math.floor(len / 3) >= 2` is exactly `len >= 6`, the point where the budget stops being the floor of 2).
- **Consumers keyed on the text or on a suggestion being present: none broken.** Read in the head tree: `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` `schemaRefusalHead` is the one parser of this producer's message. It cuts at the first `'. '` and takes the rename only when the next sentence starts with `Did you mean `; an absent rename is its normal second branch, and the empty-key wording puts the first `'. '` where it was (after the key list). `ui/packages/types/src/zod/tombstone.zod.ts`, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/reference-keys.ts`, `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-body-door.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-report` compose their own sentences in the same style and do not read this one. No Studio, MCP or CLI source matches on a short-key rename. Test Core, Test UI, Type Check and the lint families are green on this head, and the diff rewrote no existing spec pin, so no existing test depended on a guess that is now withheld.
- **SQL push-down: n/a.** No query, id materialisation or join in the diff.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec` (and on metadata-protocol, plugin-security, cli) matches what the diff publishes: reworded refusal text, one withheld advisory guess class, no export or signature change. `Check Changeset` is green.

Clause-②: no — holds. The changeset and the PR body both carry `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the claim comment 7001892858 declares the same. The narrowing is of a suggestion, not of what parses, so the `(narrowing)` arm does not apply.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions[0]` (row 60's bare `invalid_union` entry at path `''`): not in this diff. It was escalated and split to #35400 by maintainer ruling 7003683081, as the PR body and the seat's final-head comment state; `protocol-metadata-issues.ts` is untouched here. Answered by the split.
- Deviation "plugin-security and two docs pages added under row 130": outside `hits`; the lane seat's.
- Deviation "first push before overlap-check": process, no effect on the tree at this head.
- Out-of-scope note "the `max(2, len/3)` budget is copied in `data/object.zod.ts`, `seed.zod.ts`, `field-value.zod.ts`, `default-value-shape.ts`": confirmed as a real divergence this PR opens, see N1. Not filed by the dev (`carrier: none`); it wants a follow-up card if the short-key screen is meant to be the rule everywhere.
- SQL push-down: nothing to flag.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts`, against the card's row 60 and its consumer `strictObject`:

- `adjacentSwapDistance` is a correct optimal-string-alignment distance (first row and column initialised to the index, transposition term read from `rows[i-2][j-2]`). `aria` → `areas` scores 2 and is withheld; `lable` → `label`, `aeras` → `areas`, `labl` → `label` score 1 and are kept, as the changeset says.
- `shortKeyScreenedGuess` keeps the old ranking (`findClosestMatches`, all candidates within budget) and takes the first that passes the screen, so a one-edit candidate still outranks a swap, and the case tie-break is kept. It compares on the same fold as the ranking, so `Label` → `label` (folded distance 0) is still offered.
- The jsdoc's three claims hold in the code: "above five characters exactly as before", "at five or fewer the budget is the floor of 2", and "`aria` → `areas` is one substitution and one insertion".
- The empty-key branch is true to its comment: with budget 2, any declared key of one or two letters was within reach of `''`, and the pin declares `id` to make that case live.
- Tried to break it: a declared `aliases` entry for a short key is still consulted first and is not screened; `guidance['']` still answers; the `oppositePoleAmbiguity` screen still runs on whatever guess survives.

`packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.test.ts` (the pin): the four cases assert the message through `strictObject`, the factory's only in-repo caller, and each one fails on the pre-change code by construction (`aria` case, empty-key case) or guards the kept behaviour (swap, one-letter slip). Agrees with the contract.

Reworded sentences outside `hits`, read against their emitters because the seat asked (not graded here): "New similar" / "新建类似" is what `perm.clone.action` draws in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`, used by both `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`; the CLI hook throws a `CLIError` with `exit: 2` and builds the pointer from the deepest prefix `findTopic` / `findCommand` resolves. Both are true to the code.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; left as accepted deviations, since a fix here would move the head):

- N1 (nit) — The jsdoc on the published `strictUnknownKeyError` still says its fallback is "matching `suggestKey` in `data/object.zod.ts`". After this change the two differ on keys of five characters or fewer: `suggestKey` and the three sibling copies still offer a two-edit guess. The sentence is now loose, and the same `aria`-class answer can still come from those four producers. Follow-up card material.
- N2 (nit) — On a short key the pole screen now sees no guess where it used to see a two-edit one, so a both-ends prescription can no longer fire for it. Reaching that needs a key within two edits of a pole-prefixed key whose remainder is one or two letters (`dat` against `startAt` / `endAt`); a whole-word axis-silent key is at least three edits from either pole (the shortest pole token is three letters) and was never reached. No declared shape was found where this bites.
- N3 (nit) — `shortKeyScreenedGuess` takes `maxDistance` but picks its branch from `key.length`; the two agree only because the single caller computes `max(2, floor(len / 3))`. Fine for a private helper with one caller.

  ```
    ↳ 失败原因: AssertionError: expected [ Array(1) ] to include 'object/pm_project'
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；

> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）
